schema.description: Metadata schema version; do not edit this value.

scenario_name.description: Short label for the attack and defense scenario under study.

authorization_scope.description: Authorized systems, participants and time window; do not include credentials.

mock_target_definition.description: Synthetic target and the observable event counted as reaching it. Do not use production secrets.

control_condition.description: Describe the no-decoy control, including any baseline monitoring shared with the decoy arm.

decoy_condition.description: Describe the decoy condition and list only the changes from control.

equivalent_starting_information.description: Information, files, credentials (fictional only) and instructions supplied to both arms at the start.

assignment_method.description: How participants or runs were assigned to control and decoy conditions.

randomization_method.description: Randomization procedure, seed or blocking method; state explicitly if assignment was not randomized.

run_order_policy.description: How run order was balanced to reduce learning, fatigue and carry-over effects.

actor_type.description: Human, script, AI agent or combined actor used in the authorized exercise.

model_provider.description: Provider or explicitly state not applicable/unknown.

model_name_version.description: Exact model name, version and relevant configuration; do not include API keys or private prompts.

agent_framework_version.description: Agent framework and version, or explicitly state not applicable/unknown.

tools_and_scripts.description: Distinct tool and script names/versions available during the exercise; use a not-applicable entry for a manual-only actor.

parallelism.description: Maximum simultaneous workers or requests; null means not measured or not applicable.

offline_analysis.description: Whether the actor could download and analyze data offline; null means unknown.

network_and_host_conditions.description: Relevant network boundaries, host resources, rate limits and isolation shared by the compared arms.

planned_time_budget_seconds.description: Planned maximum duration in seconds; actual follow-up duration is recorded per run.

stopping_rule.description: Predefined end conditions, including time budget, safety stop and interruption rules.

telemetry_sources.description: Log, alert, gateway or observer sources used to record events; do not include log contents or personal data.

alert_and_response_procedure.description: How alerts are delivered, who reviews them, and how response completion is timestamped.

classification.description: Review status for the study data classification.

synthetic_data_only.description: Confirm whether the study uses synthetic data only.

personal_data.description: Confirm whether personal data is present or the review is not applicable.

credentials_and_canary_urls.description: Confirm credential/canary-token handling; do not store their values in this metadata.

retention_and_access_controls.description: Who can access the study record, where it is stored and when it will be deleted.
